reconstruction.scope: Buddha Dhatu Jadi standing hilltop shrine: round yellow/gilded enclosed hall with maroon/gold columned outer arcade, true recessed closed portal, lobed original arcade heads/entry crest, round gray roof/maroon-gold parapet. Broad central bell/ringed conical neck/crown/open umbrella finial and eight smaller surrounding stupas. Pictured teardrop paved terrace/blue-pale boundary posts, dark gold-edged pointed-end tiered canopy, simplified original seated figures/lotus seats/small umbrellas. Upper approach/gold gateway and mapped stair descent to the retained third stair control. Exact rooms, fine copied sculpture/inscriptions, forest/solar fixtures/visitor objects and remaining lower path are not authored.

reconstruction.terrainBasis: Keep original standard6m Mapzen hill grid, native paths/water and zero building-polygon set unchanged. Model terrace uses a level occupied floor above sampled terrace/upper landing maxima, individually buried retaining sides and grade-fitted stair treads along the mapped upper descent. No ground/water cutout or terrain flattening. Coarse DEM reverses part of the pictured upper stair slope and does not resolve the summit; short upper approach/long lower treads and deep exposed retaining faces are visualization contact estimates, not surveyed hill, retaining-wall or accessible-route engineering. Only the first three mapped stair controls are authored; the remaining route stays independent.
